version: LOCK 54 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - side mission: Goods left in trust
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner; LOCK 3 and LOCK 6 regulars; River Market places (LOCK 1). Each mission is its own LOCK and queue line.

missions.title: Goods left in trust
missions.kicker: River Market · Goods left in trust
missions.button: Ghalib asks you to keep something for him

a.text: Ghalib the trader is leaving for a week and asks you to keep a cloth bag for him. In your room the stitching splits: gold rings and coins spill onto the bed. Nobody knows what is in it but Ghalib.

choices.label: Count it, sew it up and keep it safe
Take one coin - he won't notice

kept.text: You count everything twice, sew the bag shut and keep it under your mattress all week.

took.text: You put one coin in your purse and sew the bag shut.

missions.title: Ghalib comes back
missions.button: Ghalib is back for his bag

a.text: Ghalib opens the bag on the table and counts every coin and ring, as traders do.

b.text: “All of it,” he says. “And you sewed the seam better than my wife.” He tells everyone at the inn.

c.text: Ghalib counts twice. He looks at you for a long moment, takes his bag and leaves without a word.

took: A coin went missing from Ghalib's bag
